name: UGC 11105 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 11105, a spiral galaxy that hosted a Type II supernova in 2019, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2019pjs-hubble
story: A softly glowing spiral with two tightly wound arms, easily outshone by the foreground stars around it. In 2019 a Type II supernova went off here, and Hubble came to see its aftermath.

claims.text: UGC 11105 is a spiral galaxy with two tightly wound arms, outshone by surrounding foreground stars
A Type II supernova took place in UGC 11105 in 2019
SN 2019pjs is a Type II supernova at 18h04m40.34s +21d38m04.24s
SN2019PJS is a target of Hubble program 16239
